Reproduced on Linux (Pop_OS!) with identical stack. Fix seems straightforward; opened a PR. The problem is bigger than just backslashes; it's basically any parser error within a multi-line string where the column of the error exceeds the length of the line that started the string block. Even if the column was valid, it would still return a line/column combination that was not correct.

PR fixes both (and has my first adventure into Godot unit tests!)
